tools.name: allegro_search
tools.description: Search live Allegro.pl marketplace offers by phrase, with optional price range, condition and sort. Returns titles, prices, sellers and offer URLs. Data is scraped live via a stealth browser, so a call may take ~30–120s. Result shape: { source, fetchedAt, query, count, offers: [...], note } — the li

tools.name: allegro_browse_category
tools.description: Browse live Allegro.pl offers within a category (by Allegro category id or full category URL), with the same filters as allegro_search. Data is scraped live via a stealth browser, so a call may take ~30–120s.

tools.name: allegro_get_offer
tools.description: Fetch details of a single Allegro.pl offer by id or URL (title, price, seller, condition, description summary, parameters, images). Data is scraped live via a stealth browser, so a call may take ~30–120s.
